‘We do not deal with cat-tongued, honorless dogs! Take these so-called Sigmarites away.’

– Denfather Klaus Liebnitz, Deputy High Priest of Ulric

 

There is no better way to keep vermin in check.

Most folk believe cats are one of three things: witches' familiars, Ranald's divine servants (and thus untrustworthy sources of good or bad luck), or simple vermin hunters. And for all the last category massively outnumbers the first two, you would never know this given the frantic signs to ward evil whenever cats are encountered. But, for all this negative superstition, cats are owned by all levels of Old Worlder society as there is no better way to keep vermin in check.
